text:
alex: holy cow that finish 😳 double OT and the underdog pulls it out. my fantasy team is officially cursed. anyone else just lose 20 points in 90 seconds?
maria: same. benched my kicker for a RB... facepalm :facepalm:
jamie: @alex what did you do?? lineup screenshot or it didn't happen :joy:
alex: posted in #fantasy but tl;dr: started the rookie WR who fumbled at the 5 and then the defense scored on a return. catastrophic.
drew: @maria @alex PSA: waiver priority is open — i'm willing to trade a taco for a bump. /waiver bump drew ? :taco:
kelly: can we have a quick poll — pizza or ramen watch party after the game? i'm voting ramen (and band-aids). :ramen: :pizza:
jamie: ramen for sure. also @ops-bot did the cameras pick up the office bracket board on the stream?? want to brag about my Cinderella pick. :eyes:
ops-bot: [system] camera feed clipped at 47:12, posted a GIF to #random-media.
drew: also re: lineup drama — pro tip: set bench autobench for 4th quarter. trust me.
kelly: need a consolatory snack run. who volunteers to pick up? i'll Venmo.
maria: i'll donate half a pint of ice cream to the cause. or full if someone volunteers to cheerlead.
jamie: all aboard the 'never trusting live injury reports' train.
jamie: This thread should be called "waivers, wounds, and warm noodles" :laughing:
alex: thanks for the sympathy and snacks offers. if anyone wants my doomed WR for free in a trade to feel better about themselves, i will mail him. :rofl:
kelly: @alex accept the ramen and the consolation hug. see y'all at 8pm in the kitchen. :hugging_face:
